test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b487598a532128f10b39bd80ee8c8be6db2f7c4748f91a0d4feed92c64425e1c.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) First box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately top left corner element, center element and bottom left corner element shifts in clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately bottom center element, bottom right corner element, top right corner element and top center element shifts in clockwise direction.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e04a4ccf9f7ef0d12a36070697300acd76c257055f9cf127fc855dc31efa2929.png] 

2) Second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately top corner elements interchange positions while top center element remains constant.
 
• Alternately bottom elements shift one position in anti-clockwise direction horizontally.
 
• Alternately center element replaced by new element i.e ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/813561694e59fae7f2297a6ab0af174bb79759df8f151bd5a08b3b1d77eebd44.png] ' is replaced by ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ce66f20539f21ce484affa74907870d7c82ee4ab0ccd8152b17599c56646ffd.png] ' and ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff4e7c3d49cae80abf597fcf5698013fcad2e4f10703573c6f8bc7022dbec6d6.png] ' is replaced by ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6f3fb50fb21a0d86de2f821b3e16c0c5b38c9532aba87ccd4a5c18f9f7ca9d5.png] '.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f6e856b5489535525823d0a107120ec38f22f303d98d93b393ebb1f61c593b2.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1dc34a8d782becc429794e132c714f5e01be5ccb16a180b91b327bc7f3715f6.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (2)’ is the correct answer.
